enumeration: Every blob in the git tree of the baseline commit whose first line parses as a JSON object with "type": "session" and "version": 0, whatever its path or extension.
expectedRule: The first rule that matches decides "kind"; "expected" is "read" for kind "read" and "refused" otherwise. "surface-before-first-step": a system/message, user/message, assistant/message or tool/result row before the first step/start. "chunk-only-fragment": at least one row, and every row is assistant/chunk or a packed chunk row. "read": a subagent/descriptor whose version is not 3 (the user ruling: these logs must read). "compact-checkpoint-without-start": a user/message from plugin "compact" with a replacing surfaceOp and no earlier compaction/start naming its compactionId. "tool-names": a request/header whose header.tools holds a member that is not a JSON object. Otherwise "read".
storedPathRule: Each copy is stored at b150a551/<path>, except apps/web/tests/snapshots/cordis-tool-round/session.jsonl, stored with a .txt suffix: its assistant/message at event 11 cites 40 chunk seqs, which the strict released-v0 row decode rejects, and scripts/session-fixture-layout.spec.ts applies that decode to every tracked *.jsonl whose first record is a session header.
countRule: rows counts the non-empty lines after the header; events counts logical events, where a packed text-chunks, reasoning-chunks or tool-call-chunks row is one event per member; turnStarts, turnEnds and userMessages count rows of that type.
toolsSourceRule: The copied sidecar whose initial schemas replace {{tools}}: tool-schemas.expected.json beside session.jsonl and tool-schemas.N.expected.json beside session.N.jsonl (the baseline acp-snapshot naming, packages/test-support/acp-snapshot/src/suite.ts:43-48 at b150a551); none when the directory holds no sidecar under that name or the log has no {{tools}} token.
